credits.title: When Worlds Collide
credits.overview: Lana Maxwell becomes the prime suspect in the murder of her friend Veronica. Watch as her life unfolds and she deals with the challenges that being a teenager brings. Meanwhile Evelyn Jackson is going through friend group problems, and decides to make friends with a controversial figure.

credits.title: CLUCK
credits.overview: A once-timid species breaks free from its human captors. After centuries of cruel exploitation, the pack plots a bloody revenge.  An unlikely group of survivors must find the courage to fight back, or risk being picked off one by one.

credits.title: How Do You Remember The Matrix?
credits.overview: In the year 2073, where all copies of films have been lost in a sea of AI-generated replicas, two detectives seek out the original copy of 'The Matrix'.

credits.title: Hot Tin Roof
credits.overview: In a quiet suburban neighbourhood, an Old Man finds himself at the centre of a series of visitors that all seem to want something from him. As his patience disappears, so do his restraints.

credits.title: Fifteen
credits.overview: A story of the unspoken, unbreakable bond between twin brothers in the face of a deep tragedy.

credits.title: CCTV Nasty
credits.overview: After a homeless ex-filmmaker witnesses a kidnapping, he comes to believe that he is trapped in a horror movie filmed by the city's CCTV, where the only way to survive is to stay on camera - no matter what.

credits.title: Westgate
credits.overview: Over the course of one day, a single mother in Melbourne’s working-class west must draw on all of her resources as she confronts the ghosts of her past.

credits.title: Old Faces
credits.overview: A Jewish Soviet prisoner, who yearns to see his children one final time, suddenly wakes up in modern Melbourne, Australia.

credits.title: The One Who Sees: A Genesis Story
credits.overview: An adaptation of the story of Hagar and Ishmael from the book of Genesis
